sn56.29:1.1: Cattārimāni bhikkhave ariyasaccāni || katamāni cattāri || || Dukkham ariyasaccaṃ [pe] dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ || || Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri ariyasaccāni || || Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave catunnam ariyasaccānam atthi ariyasaccam pariññeyyaṃ || atthi ariyasaccam pahātabbaṃ || atthi ariyasaccaṃ sacchikātabbaṃ || atthi ariyasaccam bhāvetabbaṃ || ||
sn56.29:2.1: Katamañ ca bhikkhave ariyasaccam pariññeyyaṃ || || Dukkham bhikkhave ariyasaccam pariññeyyaṃ || dukkhasamudayam ariyasaccam pahātabbaṃ || dukkhanirodham ariyasaccaṃ sacchikātabbaṃ || dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭīpadā ariyasaccam bhāvetabbaṃ || ||
sn56.29:3.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī patipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo ti || ||
